punchline: Pritikin put his own heart where strangers could check it.
thirty_sec: Nathan Pritikin, an engineer diagnosed with heart disease in his forties, followed a plant-based diet and died in February 1985 at 69. A report in the New England Journal of Medicine in July 1985 described his arteries as soft, flexible and open, per Greger; it is one man and cannot prove the diet caused it, but it made the claim checkable.
question: What claim do you repeat with confidence that no sceptic has been able to test?
key_contrast: A claim others can check beats a claim they must trust.
